# About Al Mana

Al Mana is a Qatari conglomerate operating over 55 companies in 8 countries and employing over 3500
personnel. Industry activities include automotive distribution and services, real estate and
investments, retail, food & beverage, engineering, technology, media and entertainment. The group
covers most areas of retail including luxury goods, beauty, fashion, home interiors, watches and
jewellery. Operating over 300 outlets, Al Mana represents some of the largest and most successful
brands in the world.

Today, the Group’s business activities encompass a spectrum of industries and a portfolio that includes several internationally acclaimed companies. Virtually every visitor or resident of Qatar is in one way or another touched by brand Almana. # Decarbonization

## starts with intelligent technology

[
How ZF drives lower CO2 emissions
][2]

## Welcome to ZF

ZF is a global technology company supplying advanced mobility products and systems for passenger
cars, commercial vehicles and industrial technology. Its comprehensive product range is primarily
aimed at vehicle manufacturers, mobility providers and start-up companies in the fields of
transportation and mobility. ZF electrifies a wide range of vehicle types. With its products, the
company contributes to reducing emissions, protecting the climate as well as enhancing safe
mobility.

** Click on (+) to learn more about our products and technologies**

Hotspot 1 Technology

## Technology

We want to actively shape the future of technology for mobility and industry. Our aim is to convert
today’s potential into tomorrow’s competitive advantages.

[
How we shape the future
][3]
Hotspot 2 Products

## Products

We supply mobility systems for passenger cars, commercial vehicles and industrial technology. ZF
offers comprehensive product and software solutions for established vehicle manufacturers and newly
emerging transport and mobility service providers.

[
Our product portfolio
][4]
Hotspot 3 Aftermarket

## Aftermarket

As one of the leading companies in the aftermarket industry, ZF bridges the gap between today's and
tomorrow's needs by delivering what workshops, distributors, and fleets require across the board.

[
Our aftermarket product portfolio
][5]

Alongside the automotive sector – passenger cars and commercial vehicles – ZF also serves market
segments such as construction and agricultural machinery, wind power, marine propulsion, rail drives
and test systems.

With some 153,000 employees worldwide, ZF reported sales of €38.8 billion in fiscal year 2025. The
company operates 162 production locations in 29 countries.

## Press Releases

Use our Press Center to find press releases as well as photos and videos from all areas and on all
topics within ZF Group.
[
ZF Press Center
][6]

## Stories and Highlights

Dive deeper into ZF Group and learn more about its global activities. Our stories provide new
insights.

### High-Tech From ZF for a Better Driving Experience

We develop technical solutions that can make journeys in a passenger car safer, more comfortable,
and more enjoyable. Through our innovations, we improve and simplify everyday mobility for millions
of people around the world. Discover here a wide range of passenger car products from various fields
that are transforming driving into a whole new experience.
[
Climb in and enjoy the ride!
][7]
[

### A Dynamic, Low-emission Path to the Future

As freight traffic on roads around the world continues to grow, the decarbonization of heavy-duty
trucks is becoming increasingly important. With the TraXon 2 Hybrid, ZF is developing a driveline
solution that reduces greenhouse gas emissions while meeting upcoming, more stringent emissions
standards.

trucks is becoming increasingly important. With the TraXon 2 Hybrid, ZF is developing a driveline

In this interview, Dr. Peter Holdmann outlines ZF’s R&D mission amid a rapidly transforming mobility
landscape. He shares how AI is reshaping engineering, how ZF is preparing for the Software-defined
Vehicle, and how initiatives such as Chassis 2.0, electrification, and decarbonization are
strengthening the company’s competitive position.

# COS2026

# **4^{th} Conference on Sustainability (COS2026)**

## **November 9-11, 2026, Győr, Hungary**

 

## The Conference on Sustainability series aims to give participants a forum to exchange wisdom,
## knowledge, tips, and personal experiences on a wide range of topics related to sustainability
## (see the detailed list of topics below). The COS series gives an opportunity for researchers from
## academia, industry, and professional institutions across the world to discuss their experiences
## with the development and application of novel and innovative sustainable technologies,
## sustainable systems, sustainable development, and many more. The COS series is organized by the
## Sustainability Competence Center at the Széchneyi István University in Győr.

## The COS series started in 2023, and over the past three years, we have had the opportunity to
## host over 400 section presentations and 25 plenary speakers at our conferences.

# COS2026

# **4^{th} Conference on Sustainability (COS2026)**

## **November 9-11, 2026, Győr, Hungary**

 

## The Conference on Sustainability series aims to give participants a forum to exchange wisdom,
## knowledge, tips, and personal experiences on a wide range of topics related to sustainability
## (see the detailed list of topics below). The COS series gives an opportunity for researchers from
## academia, industry, and professional institutions across the world to discuss their experiences
## with the development and application of novel and innovative sustainable technologies,
## sustainable systems, sustainable development, and many more. The COS series is organized by the
## Sustainability Competence Center at the Széchneyi István University in Győr.

## The COS series started in 2023, and over the past three years, we have had the opportunity to
## host over 400 section presentations and 25 plenary speakers at our conferences.

[IPC-255: International Standard for Digital Twins][186] Revision: • Published 12/01/0020

This standard establishes the IPC Digital Twin, which is comprised of the Digital Twin Product,
Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle frameworks. Within the Digital Twin
Architecture, this standard stipulates and defines Digital Twin properties, types, complexities and
readiness levels. The IPC Digital Twin includes historical information about a product, including
the history of design in terms of revision and engineering changes, and manufacturing information,
that many refer to as the Digital Thread.

This standard enables any manufacturer, design organization or solution provider to initiate
application interoperability to create smart value chains, as well as the mechanism to assess their
current IPC Digital Twin readiness level.

This standard provides the information and guidance necessary to understand a full IPC Digital Twin,
Digital Twin Product, Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle. This standard also
provides information and guidance on how organizations benefit from the IPC Digital Twin, how to
assess IPC Digital Twin readiness level and how to prepare an organization of any size or production

WELCOME
GROUPAUTO International is one of the world’s largest original spare parts distribution and service
& repair networks for Passenger cars and Commercial vehicles.
« Covering 5 continents and 118 countries, the international network brings together over 1951
distributors, 14956 points of sale, 6613 garages for passenger cars and 965 workshops for commercial
vehicles. »
For private individuals and professionals, GROUPAUTO independent distributors and repair workshops,
together with over 71 partner suppliers of original parts, represent an alternative to the service
networks of the vehicle manufacturers, with an equivalent quality of products and services. The only
difference is the cost.
GROUPAUTO is also an active member of FIGIEFA (International Federation of European Automotive
Aftermarket Distributors) to provide independent repairers with support in the competition to car
manufacturers’ service networks and to ensure that consumers receive fair and competitive services.

# KIA Niro: manuals and technical data

KIA Niro owners manuals | KIA Niro service and repair manuals, user guides and other information


[KIA Niro Owners and Service manualsKIA Niro: manuals and technical data]

This Owner's Manual and Service Manual will acquaint you with the operation of features and
equipment that are either standard or optional on this vehicle, along with the maintenance needs of
this vehicle. Therefore, you may find some descriptions and illustrations not appli-cable to your
vehicle. You are advised to read this publication carefully and follow the instructions and
recommendations.

Innovation is central to this versatile crossover. You can see this in the bold design: everything
here is about smart choices for a clean future. To advanced technology, connectivity and safety.
Niro is in three variants: the Niro Hybrid, Niro Plug-In Hybrid and the 100% electric Niro EV.

The Kia Niro is packed with innovation and new impressions. Changes are everywhere. And you can add
even more. Let your Niro represent your own lifestyle by customizing it with individual styling
options, even more comfort and extra protection. Choose from a wide range of accessories
characterized by beautiful design, materials of the highest quality, precise technology and perfect
fit.

### [KIA Niro EV, Hybrid - Second generation - (SG2) (2021-2024) - Owner's manual][7]

An electric vehicle is driven using a battery and an electric motor. While general vehicles use an
internal combustion engine and gasoline as fuel, electric vehicles use electrical energy that is
charged & stored inside the high voltage battery. As a result, electric vehicles are ecofriendly in
that they do not require fuel and do not emit exhaust gases. A high performance electric motor is
used in the vehicle as well. Compared to standard, internal combustion engine vehicles, engine noise
and vibrations are much more minimal when driving.

### [Kia Niro - First generation - (DE) (2017-2022) - Service and Repair Manual][8]

The Kia Niro First Generation (2017-2022) is using the electrical energy that is charged & stored
inside the high voltage battery. This method prevents air pollution since fuel, like gasoline, is
not required, negating the emission of exhaust gases. When decelerating or driving downhill,
regenerative braking is utilized to charge the high voltage battery. This minimizes energy loss and
increases the distance to empty. The vehicle is composed of a high voltage battery that drives the
motor, air conditioner, and charges an auxiliary battery (12 V) that drives all other 12 V systems.

## What Are Mobile Homes?

Mobile homes, also known as manufactured homes, have come a long way since their early days.
Originally designed for easy mobility, these homes were built on steel frames with wheels, allowing
them to be moved from place to place. But in today's world, the term “mobile home” is a bit of a
misnomer. Since 1976, when the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD) introduced the
national standardized building code, homes like these are now more commonly called manufactured
homes. While the idea of mobility remains, most manufactured homes stay put once they're set up.

### What's the Difference Between a Mobile Home and a Manufactured Home?

The distinction between a mobile home and a manufactured home boils down to when they were built and
the standards they follow. If a home was built before June 15, 1976, it's considered a mobile
home—built in an era before federal regulations were in place. On the other hand, homes constructed
after that date are known as manufactured homes. These homes are built to meet HUD's federal
standards. So, while the terms might seem interchangeable, they actually reflect different eras of
home construction.

### What Is the Difference Between a Modular Home and a Manufactured Home?

While manufactured homes and modular homes might seem similar at first glance, they have some key
differences. Manufactured homes are built entirely in a factory and transported to the home site on
a permanent chassis, which means they can technically be moved again if needed. Modular homes,
however, are built in sections or modules that are transported to the site and assembled. Modular
homes offer a variety of architectural styles, like Cape Cod or “mansion-style” luxury homes that
are different from the typical single-floor ranch style of most manufactured homes.

Both types of homes offer unique benefits, so it's important to know what you're looking for when
deciding between the two. The best news? You can find manufactured and modular homes on
MHVillage.com!

About us

## Who we are.

**Since 1914, mobility starts with SEG Automotive: Our company’s history literally began with the
invention of the first starter motors and generators.**

Over a century later, we have become a leading global supplier of powertrain components for the
automotive industry – for passenger cars, commercial vehicles, light electric vehicles and in the
aftermarket.

Our rotating machines power over 300 million vehicles on the road today – while significantly
reducing their CO2 emissions – and our innovations and e-machines drive the transition towards a
sustainable, electrified mobility.

At the heart of this success is our cross-cultural team of around 6,000 employees in 14 countries in
the world’s most important automotive markets.




[ Find out more about our company ][58]

## Our vision.

In the early 20th century, cars actually needed to be started by hand. Ever since making hand
cranking obsolete by inventing the first electric starter motor, we are driven by the same
motivation: to make mobility safe, reliable, and efficient.



Since then, #wearethemotor for our industry – both with our products and our innovations.

Now, to combat climate change, mobility faces its greatest transformation: to become green,
electrified, sustainable. We at SEG Automotive are committed to speeding up this vital change by
leveraging our 100 years of experience in developing and manufacturing e-motors.

We are the motor – for the mobility of today and tomorrow. This is our vision, and our
responsibility.

Products

## What we do.

We are valued across the globe for our reliable, efficient rotating machines that greatly reduce
emissions. Extreme temperatures, tough road conditions or long periods of use – we have the right
solution for any type of engine and application. Accordingly, virtually all major vehicle
manufacturer rely on our products to power their cars and commercial vehicles.

From product platforms for conventional 12V powertrains and 48V Hybrids to highly customizable

# Decarbonization

## starts with intelligent technology

[
How ZF drives lower CO2 emissions
][2]

## Welcome to ZF

ZF is a global technology company supplying advanced mobility products and systems for passenger
cars, commercial vehicles and industrial technology. Its comprehensive product range is primarily
aimed at vehicle manufacturers, mobility providers and start-up companies in the fields of
transportation and mobility. ZF electrifies a wide range of vehicle types. With its products, the
company contributes to reducing emissions, protecting the climate as well as enhancing safe
mobility.

** Click on (+) to learn more about our products and technologies**

Hotspot 1 Technology

## Technology

We want to actively shape the future of technology for mobility and industry. Our aim is to convert
today’s potential into tomorrow’s competitive advantages.

[
How we shape the future
][3]
Hotspot 2 Products

## Products

We supply mobility systems for passenger cars, commercial vehicles and industrial technology. ZF
offers comprehensive product and software solutions for established vehicle manufacturers and newly
emerging transport and mobility service providers.

[
Our product portfolio
][4]
Hotspot 3 Aftermarket

## Aftermarket

As one of the leading companies in the aftermarket industry, ZF bridges the gap between today's and
tomorrow's needs by delivering what workshops, distributors, and fleets require across the board.

[
Our aftermarket product portfolio
][5]

Alongside the automotive sector – passenger cars and commercial vehicles – ZF also serves market
segments such as construction and agricultural machinery, wind power, marine propulsion, rail drives
and test systems.

With some 153,000 employees worldwide, ZF reported sales of €38.8 billion in fiscal year 2025. The
company operates 162 production locations in 29 countries.

that are transforming driving into a whole new experience.

# COS2026

# **4^{th} Conference on Sustainability (COS2026)**

## **November 9-11, 2026, Győr, Hungary**

 

## The Conference on Sustainability series aims to give participants a forum to exchange wisdom,
## knowledge, tips, and personal experiences on a wide range of topics related to sustainability
## (see the detailed list of topics below). The COS series gives an opportunity for researchers from
## academia, industry, and professional institutions across the world to discuss their experiences
## with the development and application of novel and innovative sustainable technologies,
## sustainable systems, sustainable development, and many more. The COS series is organized by the
## Sustainability Competence Center at the Széchneyi István University in Győr.

## The COS series started in 2023, and over the past three years, we have had the opportunity to
## host over 400 section presentations and 25 plenary speakers at our conferences.

# COS2026

# **4^{th} Conference on Sustainability (COS2026)**

## **November 9-11, 2026, Győr, Hungary**

 

## The Conference on Sustainability series aims to give participants a forum to exchange wisdom,
## knowledge, tips, and personal experiences on a wide range of topics related to sustainability
## (see the detailed list of topics below). The COS series gives an opportunity for researchers from
## academia, industry, and professional institutions across the world to discuss their experiences
## with the development and application of novel and innovative sustainable technologies,
## sustainable systems, sustainable development, and many more. The COS series is organized by the
## Sustainability Competence Center at the Széchneyi István University in Győr.

## The COS series started in 2023, and over the past three years, we have had the opportunity to
## host over 400 section presentations and 25 plenary speakers at our conferences.

[IPC-255: International Standard for Digital Twins][186] Revision: • Published 12/01/0020

This standard establishes the IPC Digital Twin, which is comprised of the Digital Twin Product,
Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle frameworks. Within the Digital Twin
Architecture, this standard stipulates and defines Digital Twin properties, types, complexities and
readiness levels. The IPC Digital Twin includes historical information about a product, including
the history of design in terms of revision and engineering changes, and manufacturing information,
that many refer to as the Digital Thread.

This standard enables any manufacturer, design organization or solution provider to initiate
application interoperability to create smart value chains, as well as the mechanism to assess their
current IPC Digital Twin readiness level.

This standard provides the information and guidance necessary to understand a full IPC Digital Twin,
Digital Twin Product, Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle. This standard also
provides information and guidance on how organizations benefit from the IPC Digital Twin, how to
assess IPC Digital Twin readiness level and how to prepare an organization of any size or production
volume to implement a full IPC Digital Twin approach to

WELCOME
GROUPAUTO International is one of the world’s largest original spare parts distribution and service
& repair networks for Passenger cars and Commercial vehicles.
« Covering 5 continents and 118 countries, the international network brings together over 1951
distributors, 14956 points of sale, 6613 garages for passenger cars and 965 workshops for commercial
vehicles. »
For private individuals and professionals, GROUPAUTO independent distributors and repair workshops,
together with over 71 partner suppliers of original parts, represent an alternative to the service
networks of the vehicle manufacturers, with an equivalent quality of products and services. The only
difference is the cost.
GROUPAUTO is also an active member of FIGIEFA (International Federation of European Automotive
Aftermarket Distributors) to provide independent repairers with support in the competition to car
manufacturers’ service networks and to ensure that consumers receive fair and competitive services.
[Günter Weber]

# KIA Niro: manuals and technical data

KIA Niro owners manuals | KIA Niro service and repair manuals, user guides and other information


[KIA Niro Owners and Service manualsKIA Niro: manuals and technical data]

This Owner's Manual and Service Manual will acquaint you with the operation of features and
equipment that are either standard or optional on this vehicle, along with the maintenance needs of
this vehicle. Therefore, you may find some descriptions and illustrations not appli-cable to your
vehicle. You are advised to read this publication carefully and follow the instructions and
recommendations.

Innovation is central to this versatile crossover. You can see this in the bold design: everything
here is about smart choices for a clean future. To advanced technology, connectivity and safety.
Niro is in three variants: the Niro Hybrid, Niro Plug-In Hybrid and the 100% electric Niro EV.

The Kia Niro is packed with innovation and new impressions. Changes are everywhere. And you can add
even more. Let your Niro represent your own lifestyle by customizing it with individual styling
options, even more comfort and extra protection. Choose from a wide range of accessories
characterized by beautiful design, materials of the highest quality, precise technology and perfect
fit.

### [KIA Niro EV, Hybrid - Second generation - (SG2) (2021-2024) - Owner's manual][7]

An electric vehicle is driven using a battery and an electric motor. While general vehicles use an
internal combustion engine and gasoline as fuel, electric vehicles use electrical energy that is
charged & stored inside the high voltage battery. As a result, electric vehicles are ecofriendly in
that they do not require fuel and do not emit exhaust gases. A high performance electric motor is
used in the vehicle as well. Compared to standard, internal combustion engine vehicles, engine noise
and vibrations are much more minimal when driving.

### [Kia Niro - First generation - (DE) (2017-2022) - Service and Repair Manual][8]

The Kia Niro First Generation (2017-2022) is using the electrical energy that is charged & stored
inside the high voltage battery. This method prevents air pollution since fuel, like gasoline, is
not required, negating the emission of exhaust gases. When decelerating or driving downhill,
regenerative braking is utilized to charge the high voltage battery. This minimizes energy loss and
increases the distance to empty. The vehicle is composed of a high voltage battery that drives the
motor, air conditioner, and charges an auxiliary battery (12 V) that drives all other 12 V systems.

## What Are Mobile Homes?

Mobile homes, also known as manufactured homes, have come a long way since their early days.
Originally designed for easy mobility, these homes were built on steel frames with wheels, allowing
them to be moved from place to place. But in today's world, the term “mobile home” is a bit of a
misnomer. Since 1976, when the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD) introduced the
national standardized building code, homes like these are now more commonly called manufactured
homes. While the idea of mobility remains, most manufactured homes stay put once they're set up.

### What's the Difference Between a Mobile Home and a Manufactured Home?

The distinction between a mobile home and a manufactured home boils down to when they were built and
the standards they follow. If a home was built before June 15, 1976, it's considered a mobile
home—built in an era before federal regulations were in place. On the other hand, homes constructed
after that date are known as manufactured homes. These homes are built to meet HUD's federal
standards. So, while the terms might seem interchangeable, they actually reflect different eras of
home construction.

### What Is the Difference Between a Modular Home and a Manufactured Home?

While manufactured homes and modular homes might seem similar at first glance, they have some key
differences. Manufactured homes are built entirely in a factory and transported to the home site on
a permanent chassis, which means they can technically be moved again if needed. Modular homes,
however, are built in sections or modules that are transported to the site and assembled. Modular
homes offer a variety of architectural styles, like Cape Cod or “mansion-style” luxury homes that
are different from the typical single-floor ranch style of most manufactured homes.

Both types of homes offer unique benefits, so it's important to know what you're looking for when
deciding between the two. The best news? You can find manufactured and modular homes on
MHVillage.com!

## Частые вопросы

Каковы сроки доставки и от чего они зависят?
Доставка из Южной Кореи до Владивостока занимает от 2 до 3 недель, а из Японии и Китая — от 3 до 4
недель. Сроки зависят от удаленности площадки выкупа от экспортного порта, расписания морских судов,
скорости оплаты инвойса клиентом и загруженности таможенного поста во Владивостоке.
Как считается итоговая стоимость?
Цена авто на аукционе + доставка до РФ + таможенная пошлина + утильсбор + СБКТС + наша фиксированная
комиссия. Никаких скрытых платежей.
Производится ли страховка автомобиля?
Да, все автомобили в обязательном порядке страхуются на полную стоимость на каждом этапе
транспортировки — от выкупа на зарубежной площадке до выдачи во Владивостоке.
Можно ли посмотреть авто до покупки?
Конечно. На площадках зачастую есть схема дефектов автомобиля, в соответствии с требованиями клиента
ориентируемся на состояние авто. Так же наш специалист на месте делает технический осмотр и
исследование кузова с помощью толщиномера, после чего высылает подробный фото-отчет и техническое
заключение.
Кто организует доставку?
Доставку до Владивостока организует наш партнер — международная логистическая компания Феникс Азия.
После растаможки вы можете забрать автомобиль самостоятельно во Владивостоке либо мы организуем
доставку в ва 🎁 **Подбор и консультация — бесплатно** · Платите только за выбранное авто

Конечно. На площадках зачастую есть схема дефектов автомобиля, в соответствии с требованиями клиента
ориентируемся на состояние авто. Так же наш специалист на месте делает технический осмотр и
исследование кузова с помощью толщиномера, после чего высылает подробный фото-отчет и техническое
заключение.
Кто организует доставку?
Доставку до Владивостока организует наш партнер — международная логистическая компания Феникс Азия.
После растаможки вы можете забрать автомобиль самостоятельно во Владивостоке либо мы организуем
доставку в ваш регион автовозом или железной дорогой. Доставка из Владивостока оплачивается отдельно
и не входит в изначальную стоимость на сайте.
Предоставляется ли техническая гарантия на автомобиль?
Юридически мы выступаем вашим агентом по импорту, поэтому предоставить техническую гарантию на
подержанный автомобиль не можем. Однако японские аукционы и корейские дилеры несут строгую
юридическую ответственность перед законом за достоверность аукционного листа и заявленного состояния
автомобиля, за умышленное сокрытие дефектов или скрученный пробег их лишают лицензий!
Какие авто вы НЕ привозите?
Не возим автомобили старше 2008 года — из-за повышенных таможенных ставок и высоких рисков по
техсостоянию. Также не работаем с авто после серьёзных ДТП и без документов.
Зачем нужна временная прописка в ДВФО при растаможке?
Владивостокская таможня регистрирует ввозимые физическими лицами автомобили без личного присутствия
только при наличии прописки в Дальневосточном федеральном округе. Чтобы вам не пришлось лично лететь
во Владивосток для подачи документов, мы помогаем оформить временную регистрацию в ДВФО через портал
Госуслуги, что позволяет растаможить машину дистанционно и абсолютно законно.
Работаете ли с регионами?
Доставляем во все регионы России — автовозом или индивидуальным транспортом. Стоимость доставки
рассчитывается отдельно для каждого города.

About us

## Who we are.

**Since 1914, mobility starts with SEG Automotive: Our company’s history literally began with the
invention of the first starter motors and generators.**

Over a century later, we have become a leading global supplier of powertrain components for the
automotive industry – for passenger cars, commercial vehicles, light electric vehicles and in the
aftermarket.

Our rotating machines power over 300 million vehicles on the road today – while significantly
reducing their CO2 emissions – and our innovations and e-machines drive the transition towards a
sustainable, electrified mobility.

At the heart of this success is our cross-cultural team of around 6,000 employees in 14 countries in
the world’s most important automotive markets.




[ Find out more about our company ][58]

## Our vision.

In the early 20th century, cars actually needed to be started by hand. Ever since making hand
cranking obsolete by inventing the first electric starter motor, we are driven by the same
motivation: to make mobility safe, reliable, and efficient.



Since then, #wearethemotor for our industry – both with our products and our innovations.

Now, to combat climate change, mobility faces its greatest transformation: to become green,
electrified, sustainable. We at SEG Automotive are committed to speeding up this vital change by
leveraging our 100 years of experience in developing and manufacturing e-motors.

We are the motor – for the mobility of today and tomorrow. This is our vision, and our
responsibility.
